body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two enemies encountered along a path of up to 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Move along the path; make the same attack against each target when it is within melee Weapon Range. On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.

surges.html: Ignore difficult terrain along the path.
Deal +1 Damage to one hit target.

rider.title: Combo - Blitz
rider.html: After resolving, spend 2 Combo to end in an empty space adjacent to either hit target without triggering movement Reactions; that space must be within 2 units.
